headline: Approved a site plan amendment at 187 Hampstead Road and a 12-month extension for the Humphrey Road project; granted six waivers at 57 Crystal Avenue.
summary: Approved a site plan amendment for Bird Enterprises at 187 Hampstead Road, with conditions. Neighbors raised concerns about noise, water use, and wetlands. Members also approved a 12-month extension for the Humphrey Road project and granted waivers for the Qdoba and Santander Bank redevelopment at 57 Crystal Avenue.
decisions: Approved Escrow #26-31 for the Birch Street Subdivision, 9-0.
Approved Escrow #26-32 for the 75.5 Fordway Extension Subdivision, 9-0.
Approved the minutes of the August 05, 2026 meeting, with Chase and Pelletier abstaining.
Approved a 12-month extension for the mixed use development at 1, 2, 3, and 4 Humphrey Road, with a new expiration date of September 18, 2027, 9-0.
Found the façade renovation of Royal T Carwash at 20 Folsom Road appropriate for the Industrial II Zoning District, 9-0.
Approved the sign design for On the Road to Wellness at 16 Manning Street, Unit 101, 9-0.
Failed motion to find the Bird Enterprises amendment at 187 Hampstead Road a development of regional impact; 9 members voted no.
Approved the amended site plan for Bird Enterprises at 187 Hampstead Road, with conditions, 9-0.
Failed motion to find the Cafua Realty redevelopment at 57 Crystal Avenue a development of regional impact; 9 members voted no.
Granted six waivers for the 57 Crystal Avenue redevelopment, including the dumpster setback and drive aisle widths, 9-0.
Found the 57 Crystal Avenue design in substantial compliance with the Architectural Design Regulations, 9-0.
Agreed with the findings of fact for 57 Crystal Avenue, 9-0.
Struck the condition to reduce foot candles at the property lines, allowing the lighting to remain as designed, 9-0.
Continued the earlier finding that the JAL, LLC Forest Street proposal does not meet the definition of a development of regional impact; no member objected and no vote was taken.
Approved subdividing three lots into six and adjusting lot lines on Forest Street for JAL, LLC, 9-0.
